summary: learn.sessionboard.com hosts a 29-video tutorial catalog that maps SessionBoard's full product surface across 8 sections: Program & Agenda (create session, session settings, agenda building, AI agenda builder, accept & decline sessions, embeds), Submissions & Forms (session submission form, forms, fields, file requests), Contacts & Data (create contact, importing data, history), Portals (Portals Pro, custom portals, portal settings & appearance, tasks, files, session files, resources & wiki pages), Evaluations (evaluation plans, AI evaluations), Communications (creating & sending emails, email templates), Reporting & AI (reports, AI content remix), Event Team & Settings (event team, event details, record settings). Three featured videos signal the core loop: create a session, build the submission form, send emails. Detail pages reveal concrete UI: a 4-part form builder (welcome screen, session info page with locked Title/Description, speaker info page with locked first/last/email, settings with close date, 5-day/1-day reminders, up-to-15 speaker limit, up to 24 forms/event) and an evaluation-plan wizard (assign evaluators, anonymized review, Monday reminder emails, session filters, field visibility, custom questions, star/heart/face/number ratings, weighted rubrics totaling 100%).
personas: organizer/admin (primary tutorial audience: builds forms, sessions, agendas, plans, emails)
speaker/submitter (submits via public form; uses portal for tasks, files, wiki)
evaluator/reviewer (event-team member assigned to evaluation plans; scores filtered sessions)
event team member (invited collaborators with roles in Event Team settings)

user_journeys.name: Build and publish a CFP submission form
steps: From Dashboard click 'manage forms' (or Sessions module > Forms)
Open the default form or click 'Create additional forms' (up to 24 per event)
Configure Welcome screen: internal form name, external title, headers (15-char limit), welcome message
Customize Session Information page: Title and Description are required and non-removable; add custom questions, labels, help text
Customize Speaker Information page: First name/Last name/Email locked; add section headers, rich text blocks, dividers
Set Form Settings: close date, reminder emails (5 days and 1 day before), admin notification recipients, speaker limit (max 15), submission frequency limit, confirmation email, success message
Save and copy the public form link
user_journeys.filled_state: Forms list shows a default form plus 1-2 custom forms with open/closed status; form preview renders a multi-step public form with welcome text, session fields, speaker fields, and a visible close date.

user_journeys.name: Submit a session proposal
steps: Open the public form URL
Read welcome screen and continue
Fill session title, description, and custom questions
Fill speaker first/last/email plus extra fields; add co-speakers up to the configured limit
Submit and see the custom success message; confirmation email is sent
user_journeys.filled_state: Admin submissions list gains a pending session (e.g. 'Scaling LLM Evals in Production') linked to speaker contact records; speaker sees the success message.

user_journeys.name: Create an evaluation plan and score submissions
steps: Open Evaluations module, click 'add plan'
Choose 'assign evaluators' type
Enter plan title and instructions; set toggles: plan is open (with due date), anonymized review, weekly Monday reminders, include uploaded files
Check evaluator names (must be pre-added to event team)
Apply session filters: track, tags, format, level, language, status
Choose which session/speaker fields evaluators can see
Add custom evaluation questions; use ellipsis menu for required/help text
Configure rating: icon style (stars/hearts/faces/numbers) with colors; weighted rubric criteria totaling 100%; per-submission evaluation limit
Click 'add plan'; evaluator logs in, opens plan, rates each filtered session
user_journeys.filled_state: Plans list shows 'Round 1 Committee Review' with evaluator count and due date; reviewer view lists filtered anonymized sessions with star widgets; sessions accumulate average scores.

user_journeys.name: Program sessions and build the agenda
steps: In Program module create a session (title, description, format, track)
Adjust session settings / record settings
Accept or decline submitted sessions (bulk decisioning)
Open agenda builder and place accepted sessions into day/time/room slots
Optionally run AI agenda builder to auto-propose the schedule (inferred)
Generate an embed to publish the agenda on the event website
user_journeys.filled_state: Agenda grid shows 2 days x 3 rooms with colored session blocks; sessions list shows Accepted/Declined statuses; an embed snippet is available to copy.

user_journeys.name: Onboard speakers through a portal
steps: Enable Portals (Pro tier) and/or create custom portals
Configure portal settings & appearance (branding)
Assign tasks to speakers, including bulk assignment
Create file requests and session-file upload slots
Publish resources & wiki pages
Speaker logs into portal, completes tasks, uploads requested files, reads resources
user_journeys.filled_state: Organizer portal dashboard shows per-speaker task completion; speaker portal shows a task checklist (e.g. 'Upload headshot', 'Sign release'), uploaded slide deck against their session, and a wiki page.

user_journeys.name: Communicate with participants and report
steps: Open Communications, create an email without leaving the platform
Pick or create an email template (e.g. acceptance notice)
Select recipients (speakers/submitters) and send
Check contact History for logged activity
Run Reports for submission/evaluation metrics; optionally use AI content remix on session content
user_journeys.filled_state: Templates list shows acceptance/decline templates; sent-email log has entries; contact records show history timeline; a report table of submissions by track is viewable.

user_journeys.name: Import and manage contacts
steps: Open Contacts & Data module
Create a single contact manually
Run Importing Data flow: upload CSV, map columns, confirm (inferred standard mapping wizard)
Open a contact record and review History of changes/activity
user_journeys.filled_state: Contacts list shows ~10 imported people with names/emails/companies; a contact detail page shows a history/audit trail.

rubric.criterion: Submission form builder exposes the 4-part structure: Welcome screen (internal name + external title + welcome message), Session Information page, Speaker Information page, and Form Settings.
auto_steps: Log in as organizer
From Dashboard click 'manage forms' (or Sessions/Submissions area > Forms)
Open the default form or create a new one
Navigate each builder section: welcome, session info, speaker info, settings
Screenshot each section
rubric.pass_criteria: All four configuration areas exist (naming may differ) and each shows its expected controls: welcome text fields; session field list; speaker field list; settings panel.
rubric.evidence: 4 screenshots, one per builder section, plus the forms list showing at least one form.

rubric.criterion: Required system fields are locked: Title and Description on the session page, First name/Last name/Email on the speaker page cannot be removed; custom fields CAN be added with label and help text.
auto_steps: In the form builder open the session info page
Attempt to delete/remove Title and Description; observe disabled or absent remove control
Open speaker page; attempt same on first name, last name, email
Add one custom field with a custom label and help text; save
rubric.pass_criteria: Locked fields show no functional remove option (or removal is rejected); the custom field persists after save and appears in form preview.
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of the field lists showing lock/disabled state and the added custom field in preview.

rubric.criterion: Form settings include close date, reminder-email options, speaker limit (up to 15), confirmation email customization, and success message customization.
auto_steps: Open Form Settings in the builder
Set a close date, enable reminders, set speaker limit to 5, edit confirmation email body and success message; save
Submit a test entry via the public form and verify the custom success message renders
Verify the public form blocks adding a 6th co-speaker
rubric.pass_criteria: Settings persist after save; success message and speaker limit are enforced on the public form. UNVERIFIED by agent: actual delivery of confirmation/reminder emails (needs inbox and time passage) — human confirms receipt of confirmation email after a test submission.
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of settings panel, custom success screen after test submit, and blocked co-speaker add.

rubric.criterion: Evaluation plan wizard supports: title/instructions, assign evaluators from event team, anonymized-review toggle, due date, session filters (track/format/status etc.), field visibility selection, custom questions, rating icon choice (stars/numbers etc.), and weighted rubric criteria totaling 100%.
auto_steps: Open Evaluations module, click add plan
Enter title/instructions; enable anonymized review and a due date
Select at least one evaluator from team member checkboxes
Add a session filter (e.g. status = submitted or a track)
Uncheck one speaker field from visibility
Add a custom question; choose a star or numeric rating; create 2 rubric criteria weighted 60/40
Save plan and screenshot the plan summary/list
rubric.pass_criteria: Plan saves with all configured options visible on reopen; rubric weights validate to 100%; filtered session set matches the filter.
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of each wizard step and the saved plan detail.

rubric.criterion: Sessions can be created in the Program module and submissions can be accepted or declined with a visible status change.
auto_steps: Create a session manually in the Program/Sessions module with title and description
Verify it appears in the sessions list
Select a submitted session and use the accept action; verify status shows Accepted
Decline another session; verify status shows Declined
rubric.pass_criteria: Created session persists; accept/decline actions exist and update the visible status on the list and detail views.
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of sessions list before/after status changes and of the created session detail.

rubric.criterion: An agenda builder places accepted sessions into date/time/room slots, and an AI agenda-builder option is present.
auto_steps: Open the Agenda area
Verify a schedule grid/calendar with days, times, and rooms/tracks
Place or assign one accepted session into a slot; verify it renders as a scheduled block
Locate the AI agenda builder entry point and screenshot it
rubric.pass_criteria: Manual scheduling verified end-to-end. UNVERIFIED by agent: quality/output of AI agenda generation (nondeterministic; human reviews one AI-generated schedule for plausibility).
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of the agenda grid with a placed session and the AI builder entry point.

rubric.criterion: Speaker portal is configurable (appearance/branding, tasks incl. bulk assign, file requests, resources/wiki) and speakers get a logged-in portal view of their assignments.
auto_steps: Open Portals configuration as organizer
Change an appearance setting (logo/color) and save
Create a task and bulk-assign to 2+ speakers
Create a file request; add a resource/wiki page
Screenshot each configuration surface
rubric.pass_criteria: Organizer-side configuration all persists. UNVERIFIED by agent: the speaker-side portal experience requires a second (speaker) account — human logs in as an invited speaker and confirms the task, file request, and wiki page appear and the task can be completed.
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of portal settings, task assignment list, file request, wiki page; human-provided screenshot of speaker portal view.

rubric.criterion: In-app email: compose to selected speakers/contacts, use a saved template, and see the message logged (contact History/sent log).
auto_steps: Open Communications/Emails area
Create an email template with subject and body; save
Compose a new email, select recipients from contacts/speakers, apply the template
Send (or schedule) and screenshot the sent/queued log
Open a recipient contact record and check History for the email activity
rubric.pass_criteria: Template persists and is applicable in compose; send action produces a log entry and contact history entry. UNVERIFIED by agent: actual inbox delivery — human checks a test inbox for the received email.
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of template editor, compose with recipients, sent log, and contact history entry.

sample_data: Event: 'AI Engineer Summit 2026' (2 days, 3 rooms: Main Stage, Workshop A, Workshop B; tracks: Agents, Infra, Evals). Submission form 'CFP 2026' with welcome message, custom session fields (Format: talk/workshop; Level: intro/advanced; 'Learning objectives' long-text) and custom speaker field 'Company'; close date 2 weeks out; speaker limit 3. 6 sample proposals, e.g. 'Scaling LLM Evals in Production' (Jane Rivera, jane@examplecorp.com, Evals track), 'Multi-Agent Orchestration Patterns' (Sam Okafor), 'GPU Cost Engineering 101' (Li Wei); statuses mixed submitted/accepted/declined. Contacts CSV: 10 rows (first,last,email,company,job title). Event team: 1 admin + 2 evaluators (Alex Kim, Priya Nair). Evaluation plan 'Round 1 Committee Review': anonymized, due date +7 days, 5-star rating, rubric Relevance 40/Originality 30/Clarity 30, filter status=submitted. Email template 'Acceptance Notification' with event-name and speaker-name merge fields. Portal: tasks 'Upload headshot' and 'Confirm AV needs'; file request 'Final slide deck (PDF)'; wiki page 'Speaker FAQ'.
gaps: 26 of 29 video cards have no subtitle text on the catalog; no durations shown; video content itself (embedded players) is not transcribable via fetch, so only 2 videos yielded step-level UI detail (submission form, evaluation plans). Portals-pro detail page was a thin index. Not learnable from this source: exact navigation labels for Agenda/Reports/AI features, AI agenda-builder and AI-evaluations behavior, embed content types, import wizard mechanics, report types, pricing tiers beyond the 'Pro' badge on portals. Inferred (marked in descriptions): drag-drop agenda grid, CSV mapping wizard, embed snippet output, template merge fields, decision-email linkage, AI feature behaviors — inferred from Sessionize/Cvent/EasyChair category norms. Numeric limits (24 forms/event, 15 speakers, 15-char headers, 5-day/1-day reminders, Monday reminder emails) come from tutorial text and may have changed.
